scripts.title: 🎬 YouTube Ad Skip Pro
scripts.desc: YouTube ads auto-skip / fast-forward, overlay ads band, 'continue watching' auto-OK

scripts.title: 🧹 Ad Slots Cleaner
scripts.desc: Sab websites par ad wale dabbe, banner aur sponsored boxes chhupata hai (CSS)

scripts.title: 🙈 Shorts Hider
scripts.desc: YouTube Shorts chhupata hai; shorts wala link normal video ki tarah khulta hai

scripts.title: 📺 Background Play
scripts.desc: App band karke ya dusra app kholkar bhi video/audio chalta rehta hai (native power)

scripts.title: 🖼️ PiP Mode
scripts.desc: Video chhoti floating window me chalti hai — dusre apps ke upar (native power)

scripts.title: ⬇️ Video Download Button
scripts.desc: Page ke video par ⬇ button — direct video file download hoti hai (streaming sites par kaam nahi karega)

scripts.title: 🎧 Audio Only (YouTube)
scripts.desc: Screen kaali, sirf awaaz — data aur battery ki bachat

scripts.title: ⏩ Speed Controller
scripts.desc: Kisi bhi video/audio ki speed 0.5x–3x badlo (floating chip)

scripts.title: 🛡️ Popup & Redirect Blocker
scripts.desc: Bina tap ke khulne wale popup/redirect aur page-chhodne wale trap rokta hai

scripts.title: 📖 Reader Mode
scripts.desc: Article ko saaf karke padhne layak banata hai (floating 📖 button ON/OFF)

scripts.title: 🌗 Night Dimmer
scripts.desc: Raat ke liye screen par halki kaali parat — chamak kam, aankhein aaram (🌗 button se level)

scripts.title: 💤 Sleep Timer
scripts.desc: 15/30/45/60 minute baad chal raha media apne aap ruk jata hai
